Name: Igal, Son of Joseph
Summary: Igal, Son of Joseph was one of the twelve spies Moses sent from the tribe of Issachar to search out the land of Canaan.
KeyStory: Igal spent forty days spying out Canaan, then joined the ten who brought back a fearful report that turned Israel back into the wilderness.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Father of Igal; Moses; Caleb; Joshua
LifeLesson: Seeing the same land as Caleb, he saw only giants — faith is a choice about what you trust.
